title: One Knee
note: Bohdan's interior. His body goes to one knee before his mind decides. Palm flat to limestone. He reads joint/seam/bearing/crack. The slab is sound (~600 solar years, high-Gothic Moravian technique — impossible and possible). The mortar has an unknown mineral additive. The brass nail-line bears RESIDUAL THERMAL + UNCATEGORIZED FORCE; engine refuses to name what. Stays on one knee through chapter end.
litRPG_surface: Bohdan's OOC blocks render as :::structurebox (load-bearing audit), :::statbox (sheet + tool inventory), :::action (STRUCTURE_QUERY verbs), :::systemvoice (⟦ ⟧ engine returns).

events.trigger: slab rang faintly under boot-heel like a header whispering when a joist lets go two floors above
events.note: Body went down before mind decided. Stays in this posture through chapter end.

events.returned: MASON · L1 · HP 12/12 · AC 12 · STR 15 DEX 11 CON 15 INT 12 WIS 12 CHA 10
LIMESTONE VENEER OVER GRANITE BASE · KEYSTONE-ALIGNED COURSING · AGE ~600 SOLAR · MORTAR MATRIX CaCO₃-SiO₂-UNKNOWN MINERAL ADDITIVE · CONDITION SOUND · INTEGRITY 97%
events.bohdan_observation: Tooling marks line up to high-Gothic Moravia — impossible, unless stone chose to lie about its passport. Stone under load does not lie.

events.returned: BRASS NAIL-LINE · ORIENTATION: KEYSTONE ALIGNED · CURRENT BEARING: RESIDUAL THERMAL + UNCATEGORIZED FORCE · TEMPERATURE GRADIENT: +45 K ABOVE FLOOR MEAN
events.note: Engine REFUSED to categorize the brass's bearing. Honest return preserved. Convergence with Cole's perception fire (which returned similar UNCATEGORIZED PRESSURE) and Yuki's surveyor read (warmer than surrounding floor).

events.bohdan_reaction: Not surprise. Recognition. 'Another man has read the same thing you are reading. With different equipment.'

events.note: Bohdan does not rise in this chapter. He stays on one knee, palm to stone. The chapter in the rock is not finished writing itself yet.

ledger_state_at_chapter_end.bohdan_posture: one knee, right palm flat to limestone
ledger_state_at_chapter_end.structure_audit_logged: limestone-over-granite raft; brass bears uncategorized force; recommendation: isolate line until load dump confirmed; monitor for nail walk + joint shear
ledger_state_at_chapter_end.convergence_validated: Three independent reads of the brass nail-line (Cole's perception, Yuki's surveyor eye, Bohdan's palm) all returned the same: residual thermal + uncategorized force. The engine refused to name what across all three lenses.

agent_calls.beat: arrival — one knee — read the lay — read the brass
